lines.text: Dinner was served, and Bella the bluebird stared down at her plate with big eyes!
Eww! Little green broccoli trees! I don't like green foods! she squawked!
Have you ever tasted one? asked her papa. No, but it looks weird! Bella replied!
Papa smiled and said, How do you know if a playground is fun before you slide?
Bella took a tiny fork, dipped the broccoli tree in melted cheese, and took a bite!
CRUNCH! It was warm, savory, and super delicious like a crispy party!
Broccoli gives your wings super flying power and strengthens your bones!
Taking one brave bite can unlock your brand new favorite food!
Taste new adventures and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
